name: insights
description: Find what went wrong in yesterday's Claude Code sessions and newspaper runs, and propose one concrete fix per problem on a page in a kasten vault; kept fixes become pull requests, todos and feedback lines.

interface.shortDescription: Daily problems and fixes from your Claude Code sessions
interface.longDescription: Reads 14 days of Claude Code transcripts and the newspaper's logs through a script, groups recurring errors, guard refusals and typed corrections into problems, checks memory and the files a fix would go to, verifies causes where a check is cheap, and writes one page per day to a kasten vault with a concrete fix per problem. A review note beside the page decides: kept fixes become pull requests, todos or newspaper feedback lines; deleted ones stay rejected until their hits triple.
